title: Classic Curried Eggs
summary: Creamy curried eggs made with KEEN'S Curry Powder and Hellmann's Whole Egg Mayonnaise, seasoned simply with salt and pepper. Perfect on hot buttered toast or in a curried egg and lettuce sandwich.

ingredients.name: bread or toast
ingredients.originalText: 8 slice bread or toast, to serve

ingredients.name: lettuce leaves
ingredients.originalText: 4 leaf lettuce leaves, optional for sandwiches

steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then cook until hard-boiled, about 9–10 minutes.
Drain the eggs and cool them under cold running water. Peel and roughly chop or mash them with a fork.
Add the Hellmann's Whole Egg Mayonnaise and KEEN'S Curry Powder. Mix until creamy but still slightly textured.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Add a little more curry powder or mayonnaise if you prefer a stronger or creamier mixture.
Serve on hot buttered toast, or spoon onto bread with crisp lettuce for a curried egg and lettuce sandwich.

image.alt: Bowl of creamy curried egg made with chopped eggs, whole egg mayonnaise and curry powder, served with thick toast and lettuce.
